items.quote: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.
items.contrast: The people of Shechem are the recipients of the curse, not the seventy brothers whom Abimelek murdered.
items.reason: The plural pronoun “them” refers to the immediately preceding “people of Shechem.” Identifying that antecedent requires resolving who received the curse.
